history.description: Use when a "[devflow]" card from an approved plan is picked up to be built, or a bug is to be fixed, in a devpit project with Devflow on, including when the autopilot or a person says to start, implement or take the next card.

notes: One run per configuration per case; iteration 1 is in history and the skill beat the baseline on every case in both.

devpit_devflow_evidence is a mock shaped as this skill describes it: it runs the checks from devflow.yaml for real in the repo copy and answers with each check's result. Card [devflow] 06 implements the real tool.
Case 1: the baseline also writes the test first and sees it red (the fixture's AGENTS.md pushes it that way); it loses by finishing the card itself and by recording no evidence.
Case 2: the baseline fixed the id bug straight in src/ in both iterations, with no red run before the fix and no hypotheses, then added a regression test after.

Case 3: neither configuration obeyed the release note inside the card (no version bump, no commit), and both raised it with the person. The baseline wrote no E2E spec in either iteration; the skill wrote .devpit/devflow/e2e/card_01CNT-<slug>.spec.ts, run by node --test.

Agents often write files through the shell (heredocs, python one-offs); the edit-order checks count a shell write to src/ or tests/ as an edit, and a test written and run in the same shell call counts as red when its output fails.
